svg.title: 02 | Whole-leg / all-high-rod bottleneck distance / 全腿最小间距

g.text: 02 | Whole-leg / all-high-rod bottleneck distance / 全腿最小间距
Colored: current executable paths. Green: research candidate. Gray dots: pointwise phase-grid maxima, NOT a valid path.
Net gap / R = plotted value - (leg radius + rod radius + safety allowance) / R.
No site calibration supplied. These curves are geometric centerline distances, not hardware clearance approval.
